{c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skills grant you Conqueror for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds when hitting a Crowd Controlled enemy. {c_important}Juggernaut{/c} Skills always {u}{c_important}Overpower{/c}{/u} during Conqueror. 
This effect has a {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} second Cooldown.
